title: On Juniper, the Pug
content:
Juniper is a pug of strong opinions and weak knees. She has made clear, through years of careful negotiation, that she will sit when she wants to sit, walk when she wants to walk, and snore at whatever volume she deems appropriate for the occasion.

One might think that living with a philosopher would make a dog more amenable to argument. One would be wrong. Juniper has refuted more of my positions through sheer indifference than any peer reviewer ever has.

She is, nonetheless, wonderful.
